answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to post a stake slashed when peers attest to fraud, with reputation earned only through verified completed work. A newcomer must climb like reaching a summit, one costly attested task at a time. Fakes cannot shortcut this: thousands of identities multiply the stake at risk and the work owed, turning forgery into a losing spiral of locked capital and wasted compute. Honest agents instead build a soft, durable record, a velvet trail of successful settlements, making one trusted identity worth far more than a swarm of empty ones.
